positive: Fallback chain is defined as `es-AR -> es-419 -> es -> en`; missing keys fall through deterministically instead of the previous alphabetical-sibling accident that surfaced `de` on a Latin-American page.

query: screenshot context via formatjs extract và Puppeteer crawl gửi tới Crowdin
positive: Screenshot context is attached to every extracted message via `formatjs extract --extract-source-location` plus a Puppeteer crawl that posts the rendered frame to Crowdin.

query: ICU Apostrophe-Escaping Problem wird vom Linter vor dem Build abgefangen
positive: Parameter escaping in ICU strings uses single-quoted apostrophes to keep the original behavior; the linter flags any `'` that would accidentally disable the `{}` placeholder parser.

query: DOMPurify サニタイズは locale-specific formatting の後に実行して bidi override を防ぐ
positive: User-supplied content passes through DOMPurify after locale-specific formatting; the chain runs format first then sanitise so bidi overrides inside user text cannot break surrounding RTL layout.

query: Intl.DateTimeFormat.formatRange reemplazó el guion largo manual en date ranges
positive: Date ranges use `Intl.DateTimeFormat.formatRange`; the `2026-04-01 – 2026-04-15` dash is now locale-correct and the hand-rolled en-dash fallback got deleted from the utility module.

query: Intl.DateTimeFormat z timeZoneName longGeneric zastąpił przestarzałą lookup table
positive: Timezone names render via `Intl.DateTimeFormat` with `timeZoneName: "longGeneric"`; this replaced a static lookup table that had gone stale during the 2022 IANA zone merges.

query: Message IDs с dotted domain convention вроде checkout.button.pay_now заменили prose IDs
positive: Message IDs use the dotted domain convention like `checkout.button.pay_now`; the old prose IDs that embedded English fragments broke whenever copy shifted.

query: locale bundles werden per Route mit dynamic imports gesplittet
positive: Locale bundles are split per route via dynamic imports; the shell loads the base `en` bundle and lazy-loads additional locales so the first paint is never blocked by 40 language packs.

query: catalog files は packages/i18n/catalogs に .po と .json が共存する理由
positive: Catalog files live in `packages/i18n/catalogs/<locale>.po` and `<locale>.json` side by side; the build tolerates both because the migration from gettext to LinguiJS is still in flight.

query: les commentaires traducteur passent par JSDoc i18n et formatjs extract vers Crowdin
positive: Translator comments ride on every source string via `/* i18n: */` JSDoc blocks; `formatjs extract` picks them up and Crowdin surfaces the hint next to the translation field.

query: bug pluralización ru usó reglas inglesas porque faltaba el bundle CLDR
positive: Pluralization bugs surfaced when `ru` fell back to English plural rules because the CLDR bundle wasn't loaded; we now fail the build if any shipped locale lacks a plural rules entry.

query: Crowdin OTA SDK đẩy hotfix mobile strings mà không cần build app store mới
positive: Crowdin's OTA SDK pushes hotfixes for mobile strings without a new app store build; the 24-hour cache window is small enough for urgent copy fixes and large enough to keep API quota sane.

query: CI pseudo-locale Run erkennt hardcodierte Strings via en-XA und Playwright Snapshot
positive: The CI pseudo-locale run catches hardcoded strings: any node whose `textContent` is unchanged after the `en-XA` transform is flagged by a Playwright snapshot test as un-externalised.

query: Intl.ListFormat заменил .join для user-facing lists и обрабатывает Arabic запятые
positive: List formatting runs through `Intl.ListFormat`; the `and`/`or` variants handle Arabic's serial comma absence and the old `.join(", ")` helper is now only used for CSV export.

query: Intl.RelativeTimeFormat で yesterday を表示する numeric auto オプション
positive: Relative-time strings use `Intl.RelativeTimeFormat` with `numeric: "auto"` so English gets `yesterday` instead of `1 day ago`; the homegrown `humanize` function retired on that switch.

query: Intl.NumberFormat con estilo unit muestra 1,5 км correctamente en ruso
positive: Unit formatting uses `Intl.NumberFormat` with `style: "unit"`; `1.5 km` versus `1,5 км` renders correctly for Russian with zero custom code in the distance widget.

query: locale detection ưu tiên preferred-locale trong DB rồi Accept-Language rồi geo-IP
positive: Locale detection for logged-in users preferred-locale in the DB wins over Accept-Language; anonymous traffic falls back to geo-IP then to `en` if the header is unparseable.

query: monorepo namespace-per-package Regel verhindert message ID Kollisionen
positive: Message collisions in the monorepo land through a namespace-per-package rule; the extractor errors if two packages emit the same ID so catalogs never get silently overwritten.

query: Playwright matrix で ar と he locale の RTL レイアウト regression をキャッチ
positive: Right-to-left reviews land through a Playwright matrix that runs every route under `ar` and `he` locales; the screenshot diff gates PRs so layout regressions are caught before translators see them.

query: emoji et non-BMP survivent au pipeline grâce à ensure_ascii=False dans JSON
positive: Emoji and non-BMP plural keys survive the pipeline because every catalog step runs with `ensure_ascii=False`; a 2025 incident where JSON escaping mangled flag emoji taught us to pin the flag.

query: Translation Memory Leverage wird pro Release im Grafana Panel von Crowdin angezeigt
positive: Translation memory leverage is tracked per release; Crowdin's TM match score feeds a Grafana panel so the i18n lead can see when a copy refactor nukes translator savings.

query: chiếc ghim cam trên bảng cork đã tồn tại ba năm liên tiếp
positive: A single orange pushpin has outlasted every other pin on the shared corkboard for three years running.

query: pnpm i18n:doctor проверяет catalog parity, plural coverage и ICU syntax за один проход
positive: The i18n README now points at a runnable `pnpm i18n:doctor` script that checks catalog parity, plural coverage, and ICU syntax in one pass; new contributors ran it successfully on day one.

query: OpenFeature reemplazó las importaciones directas de LaunchDarkly SDK como abstracción
positive: Adopted OpenFeature as the flag-evaluation abstraction so the application code stops importing LaunchDarkly client directly; swapping providers is now a bootstrap-only change.

query: percentage rollout sur le checkout passe par 1 → 5 → 25 → 50 → 100 avec soak SLO
positive: Percentage rollout on the new checkout ramps 1 -> 5 -> 25 -> 50 -> 100 with a 24-hour soak at each step; error-rate SLO breach auto-pauses the progression.

query: Unleash self-hosted で in-house flag service を置き換えた理由と graceful degradation
positive: Killed the in-house flag service in favour of Unleash self-hosted; the SDK's graceful-degradation cache meant we could keep the same 'fail to last-known-good' semantics we already relied on.

query: kill-switch flags mit KS- Prefix und Runbook-Link Pflicht auf dem Dashboard
positive: Kill-switch flags get a KS- prefix and a mandatory runbook link in the description; on-call can disable them without waiting for a deploy and the dashboard surfaces them first.

query: canary rollout для payment engine v2 использует hashed customer id mod 50
positive: Canary rollout of the payment engine v2 targets a 2% user-segment carved by hashed customer id mod 50; dogfooding staff always resolve to the new branch via a prerequisite flag.

query: Flagsmith zastąpił Split.io ze względu na koszty i opcję self-hosted
positive: Switched feature flag vendor from Split.io to Flagsmith for cost reasons; the new bill sits under a tenth of the old one and the self-hosted option gives us an escape hatch.

query: PostHog maneja experimentation flags mientras ConfigCat queda para toggles simples
positive: Experimentation flags go through PostHog feature flags because they integrate directly with the analytics events; plain toggles stay on ConfigCat where experiment metadata would be noise.

query: le provider OpenFeature pour Flagsmith vit dans libs/feature-flags comme adaptateur
positive: The OpenFeature provider for Flagsmith ships as a thin adapter in libs/feature-flags; app code calls booleanValue(key, default, evaluationContext) and never sees vendor types.

query: stale flag cleanup chạy weekly job xóa flag hơn 90 ngày với 100% hoặc 0%
positive: Stale-flag cleanup runs as a weekly job: any flag older than 90 days with 100% or 0% rollout and zero variant variance gets filed as a cleanup ticket automatically.

query: die Espressomaschine im zweiten Stock hat endlich aufgehört zu tropfen
positive: The espresso machine on floor two finally stopped leaving a puddle under it after someone replaced the drip tray.

query: piranha-java lint で LaunchDarkly の archived flag を自動 PR 削除する Java monorepo
positive: piranha-java lints the Java monorepo for stale flag references; when a flag is archived in LaunchDarkly a follow-up PR is auto-opened to delete the dead branches.

query: Rails flipper alimenta toggles internos mientras LaunchDarkly maneja los de cliente
positive: Rails flipper backs the admin-only internal toggles because its ActiveRecord adapter fits naturally; customer-facing flags live on LaunchDarkly where streaming updates matter.

query: Unleash constraints ciblent plan tier, pays et beta_cohort via unleashContext
positive: User-segment targeting uses Unleash constraints on plan tier, country, and a custom beta_cohort attribute; the SDK passes these through unleashContext on every evaluation.

query: Multi-variate flag cart-layout liefert vier Varianten gewichtet 40/30/20/10
positive: Multi-variate flag 'cart-layout' serves four string variants weighted 40/30/20/10; the default is pinned in code so a provider outage serves 'classic' instead of throwing.

query: preview environments sử dụng per-PR flag prefix để cách ly khỏi staging
positive: Preview environments wire a per-PR flag prefix so a branch under review can flip flags without leaking into staging; the CI step patches evaluationContext.environment to pr-<num>.

query: flag-as-circuit-breaker para address-lookup auto-flip a modo degradado con error budget
positive: A flag-as-circuit-breaker guards the third-party address-lookup call; when error budget burns past 2% per minute the flag auto-flips to degraded mode for an hour.

query: RFC dokumentiert den Unterschied zwischen experiment und toggle mit 6-Wochen-Regel
positive: The distinction between experiment and toggle is documented in the RFC: experiments carry a hypothesis and a stop date, toggles do not; experiments must graduate or be killed within 6 weeks.

query: ConfigCat の targeting rules で product-ops が premium toggle を no-code で操作
positive: ConfigCat's targeting rules resolved simpler than we expected for plan-tier gates; the no-code editor let product-ops run the premium-only toggle without a deploy.

query: Go services importent le SDK openfeature-go avec build tag pour le provider in-memory
positive: Go services import the openfeature-go SDK; the provider factory lives in pkg/flags and is swapped by a build tag so tests default to the in-memory provider.

query: feature flag testing estrategia pina ambas variantes en matrix con pytest fixture
positive: Feature-flag testing strategy pins both variants in the test matrix for any flag that gates user-visible behaviour; a pytest fixture forces resolution per parametrize row.

query: prerequisite flag new-billing-enabled は 9 つの child flags を gate して rollback 可能
positive: Prerequisite flag 'new-billing-enabled' gates nine downstream flags; turning off the parent short-circuits resolution so the subsystem can be rolled back without touching every child.

query: PostHog заменил Amplitude плюс LaunchDarkly объединив analytics и flags
positive: PostHog replaced the separate analytics-plus-flags split across Amplitude and LaunchDarkly; single event id lets us tie flag exposure to downstream funnel events without a join job.

query: exposure event mit flag key, variant und hashed user id geht ins Warehouse
positive: Flag evaluations emit an exposure event with flag key, variant, and hashed user id; the warehouse team uses this as the source of truth for experiment analysis.

query: LaunchDarkly Relay Proxy ลด tail-latency p99 จาก 210 ms เหลือ 18 ms
positive: LaunchDarkly Relay Proxy fronts the SDKs from the edge POPs; the tail-latency at p99 dropped from 210 ms to 18 ms after we moved off the public streaming endpoint.

query: lint rule de flag hygiene prohibe defaults que coincidan con el variante on
positive: Flag hygiene lint rule forbids boolean flag defaults that match the 'on' variant; the code must default to the safe off-path so a provider outage never accidentally ships the new feature.

query: Flagsmith Java SDK は synchronous evaluator に pin して cold JVM 問題を回避
positive: The Flagsmith Java SDK is pinned to the synchronous evaluator for server-side calls; the async flavour bit us when a cold JVM resolved flags before the first poll completed.

query: Split.io traffic type concept polluait notre domaine, OpenFeature evaluationContext est plus propre
positive: Split.io's targeting trees were expressive but the traffic type concept bled vendor terminology into our domain; OpenFeature's plain evaluationContext is a cleaner fit.

query: Unleash zastąpił in-house flag system głównie by nie utrzymywać własnego SDK
positive: Unleash replaced the in-house flag system mainly because we wanted to stop owning the SDK; the community SDK set covers Node, Go, Java, Python, and Ruby which matched our stack exactly.

query: LaunchDarkly bucket-by tenant_id で tenant を割らないようにした経緯
positive: LaunchDarkly's percentage rollout hashing uses bucket-by key on tenant_id so an entire tenant always lands in the same bucket; random user-id bucketing used to split a tenant's screens.

query: feature flag SDK Initialisierung nur im Bootstrap mit constructor injection
positive: Feature-flag SDK initialisation is in the process bootstrap only; any code that needs a flag takes the client by constructor injection, never a module-level singleton.

query: webhook LaunchDarkly bị mất event nên chuyển sang poll-plus-ETag mỗi 30 giây
positive: Switched webhooks from LaunchDarkly flag-change notifications to a poll-plus-ETag diff every 30 seconds; the webhooks' at-most-once delivery was dropping important change events.

query: canary flag search-rerank-v3 se desplegó país por país NZ AU CA UK US
positive: Canary flag 'search-rerank-v3' rolled out by country: NZ -> AU -> CA -> UK -> US in weekly steps; each step waited for the previous cohort's top-line metric to hold within 1% of control.

query: LaunchDarkly streaming SDK surpasse Rails flipper au-delà de 500 rps per Redis
positive: LaunchDarkly improves on Rails flipper at our scale because its streaming SDK cuts the per-request Redis round-trip; flipper was fine under 50 rps but started adding milliseconds past 500.

query: flag_d.yaml ist der lokale Dev-Provider für Offline-Arbeit und CI Smoke
positive: flag_d.yaml is the local dev provider; it ships with every repo so engineers can work offline and the CI smoke job runs with a fixed snapshot for reproducibility.

query: experimentation platform は minimum sample size を計算してから flag を graduate させる
positive: Experimentation platform enforces a minimum sample size calculator before a flag can graduate; the CLI spits out the required N and stops product managers from calling a result early.

query: flag deprecation wymaga trzech zatwierdzeń: code owner, QA i SRE
positive: Flag deprecation flow needs three approvals: code owner, QA, and SRE; the SRE sign-off confirms no dashboards or runbooks still reference the retired flag key.

query: typed FlagSet wrapper resolvió el fanout de 38 boolean flags en orders-api
positive: Boolean flag fanout on the orders-api module hit 38 flags; the team introduced a typed FlagSet wrapper so downstream callers pass a single value object instead of 38 booleans.

query: flag-controlled database migration sử dụng expand-and-contract với reads-from-new flag
positive: Flag-controlled database migration uses expand-and-contract with a 'reads-from-new' flag; once 100% of reads pass without error for 48 hours the old column gets dropped.

query: les services Rust lisent ConfigCat via un snapshot JSON sur S3 et un résolveur maison
positive: ConfigCat's native SDKs lacked a Rust binding we trusted, so the Rust services fetch the webhook-pushed JSON snapshot from S3 and evaluate locally with a tiny in-house resolver.

query: Flagsmith identity overrides ermöglichen Varianten-Zwang mit 24-Stunden Auto-Ablauf
positive: Flagsmith identity overrides let us force a specific variant for a single customer during a support incident; the override auto-expires after 24 hours so nothing lingers.

query: CI preview job で PR ごとの flag bundle を発行し slash-command でトグル
positive: CI preview job emits a sticky flag bundle per PR that the preview URL reads; reviewers toggle variants from the PR comment via /flag slash-commands the bot handles.

query: registro de flags rechaza colisiones de key con 409 en el mono-repo
positive: When a flag key collides between two services because copy-paste, the registry rejects the second create with a 409; the mono-repo owns a single source-of-truth flags/registry.yaml.

query: OpenFeature hooks loggen exposure zentral statt an jeder einzelnen Aufrufstelle
positive: OpenFeature hooks let us add an exposure-logging hook once instead of per call-site; the hook writes to the event bus and decorates spans with the resolved variant.

query: Unleash variant stickiness là sessionId trên marketing site và userId trên product
positive: Unleash variant stickiness is set to sessionId on the marketing site and userId on the product; anonymous visitors must see a stable copy within a session even without a login.

query: flag default in code は pre-rollout の挙動と一致させて rollback safe にするルール
positive: Flag default in code must match the pre-rollout behaviour so a rollback is always 'flip the flag off'; reviewers reject PRs whose default is the new behaviour.

query: les services Ruby connectent ldclient-rb via Rails initializers avec SDK key par env
positive: Ruby services wire the ldclient-rb SDK via Rails initializers; each environment uses a distinct SDK key stored in Rails credentials so a dev machine can never hit prod flags.

query: kill-switch flag detuve al email-worker en 20 segundos durante el incidente 2026-02-09
positive: A kill-switch flag stopped a runaway email-worker in 20 seconds during the 2026-02-09 incident; the post-mortem made kill-switches a mandatory control on any external side-effecting job.

query: flag metadata enthält owner team und soft-expiry mit automatischer Slack Erinnerung
positive: Flag metadata carries an owner team and an auto-remind schedule; every flag older than its soft-expiry pings the owning Slack channel until it's closed or renewed.

query: белка на крыше дата-центра сработала датчик движения во вторник утром
positive: A stray squirrel on the roof of the data center tripped a motion sensor on Tuesday morning.

query: strangler-fig migrations sử dụng feature flags chỉ cho traffic shifting không phải design
positive: Strangler-fig migrations lean on feature flags for traffic shifting only; the domain-logic decisions live in code review and ADRs, not in the flag UI, so we don't confuse rollout with design.
